This endpoint is being deprecated. Use [KYC review endpoints](/guides/product/account-setup/customer-onboarding/api-hybrid-kyc) to verify your customers.

In certain situations, additional evidence is required to verify customers and ensure we’re compliant with the KYC regulations.

Additional Verification APIs support a list of evidences that can be found in the [Supported Evidences guide](/guides/product/account-setup/customer-onboarding/supported-evidences).

If you perform your own KYC and your customers are primarily based in the EU,
refer to this [Onboarding EU-based customers guide](/guides/product/account-setup/customer-onboarding/region/eu-onboarding) for instructions on how to use these endpoints.
